scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:tts"
scripts.dev:tts: sh -c 'if curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:5050/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "TTS já ativo em 5050 — reutilizando o servidor existente"; elif [ -x backend/.venv/bin/python ]; then backend/.venv/bin/python backend/ttsServer.py; else python3 backend/ttsServer.py; fi'
scripts.setup:tts: sh -c 'if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv --python 3.13 backend/.venv && uv pip install --python backend/.venv/bin/python kokoro-onnx soundfile; else python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install kokoro-onnx soundfile; fi'
